dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-torso toward a pointed posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight symmetrical indentations visible at the transition between the head and torso regions.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast, light-colored linear reflection or pigment ridge extends along the posterior dorsal midline.
